\subsubsection{Crystal Growth and Diffraction}
\index{RNA duplex}
\index{PEG}
\index{cryoprotectant}

The crystals of the RNA duplex grew in the forty percent PEG condition.
They are diffracting to about 1.8 angstroms at the beamline.
We cannot use the old cryoprotectant because it cracks the crystals.

\subsubsection{Molecular Dynamics Runs}
\index{molecular dynamics}
\index{base pairs}

The molecular dynamics runs have not finished yet.
The first hundred nanoseconds look stable, and the base pairs are not fraying.
